page.help: Every agent reads this doc, and meeting transcripts are corrected against it, so spell names and terms here as the company does. Agents and the review that runs every few hours propose changes beside each section; nothing changes until you approve it.

hints.company: What the company does, for whom, and where.
hints.leadership: Who leads the company, and what each of them owns.
hints.people: One person per line: their name as they spell it, how it is often misheard, and what they do.
hints.stakeholders: Clients, partners, investors, and vendors, with who speaks for each.
hints.products: What the company makes and sells.
hints.projects: The work under way, and who is on it.
hints.glossary: One term per line, alphabetically: the term as the company spells it, what it means, and how it is often misheard.
